paragraphs.zh: The plant protection agents which contain tembotrione in the form A or C combat plant growth, in particular monocotyledonous weed species such as Avena, Lolium, Alopecurus, Phalaris, Echinochloa, Digitaria, Setaria, Cyperus species, Agropyron, Cynodon, Imparato and Sorghum, and dicotyledonous weed species such as Galium, Viola, Veronica, Lamium, Stellaria, Amaranthus, Sinapsis, Ipomoea, Matricaria, Abutilon, Sida, Convolvulus, Cirsium, Rumex and Artemisia on non-cultivated areas very well, particularly at high application levels. In crops such as wheat, barley, rye, rice, maize, sugar beet, soya and cotton, they are active against weeds and noxious grasses, without harming the crop plants significantly. This effect occurs above all at low application levels.
paragraphs.en: The plant protection agents which contain tembotrione in the form A or C combat plant growth, in particular monocotyledonous weed species such as Avena, Lolium, Alopecurus, Phalaris, Echinochloa, Digitaria, Setaria, Cyperus species, Agropyron, Cynodon, Imparato and Sorghum, and dicotyledonous weed species such as Galium, Viola, Veronica, Lamium, Stellaria, Amaranthus, Sinapsis, Ipomoea, Matricaria, Abutilon, Sida, Convolvulus, Cirsium, Rumex and Artemisia on non-cultivated areas very well, particularly at high application levels. In crops such as wheat, barley, rye, rice, maize, sugar beet, soya and cotton, they are active against weeds and noxious grasses, without harming the crop plants significantly. This effect occurs above all at low application levels.
paragraphs.notes: Marker printed WITH square brackets and in bold on the image: [0088]. Every genus checked at 7x magnification. 'Imparato' is what the page prints, verified letter by letter; the grass genus is Imperata, so this is the patent's own misspelling and not an OCR artifact, and it is recorded as printed. 'Sinapsis' is likewise as printed, and the same patent spells the genus 'Sinapis alba' in [0090], so the document is internally inconsistent. The OCR layer breaks 'Sorghum' as 'Sor ghum' across the line and capitalises 'sugar' and 'soya' as 'Sugar' and 'Soya'; the image has lowercase and the hyphenated line break is rejoined here. Source language is English, so `en` repeats `zh` verbatim with no normalisation.

paragraphs.zh: The forms A and C of tembotrione are also just as suitable as the known amorphous tembotrione for the defoliation and desiccation of plant parts, for example for crop plants such as cotton, potato, rape, sunflower, soya bean or field beans, in particular cotton. In this regard, embodiments of the invention also relate to agents for the desiccation and/or defoliation of plants, processes for the production of these agents and methods for the desiccation and/or defoliation of plants using the forms A and C of tembotrione.
paragraphs.en: The forms A and C of tembotrione are also just as suitable as the known amorphous tembotrione for the defoliation and desiccation of plant parts, for example for crop plants such as cotton, potato, rape, sunflower, soya bean or field beans, in particular cotton. In this regard, embodiments of the invention also relate to agents for the desiccation and/or defoliation of plants, processes for the production of these agents and methods for the desiccation and/or defoliation of plants using the forms A and C of tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: Last paragraph in the left column, ending flush at the foot. The OCR layer capitalises 'sunflower', 'soya' and 'of tembotrione' wrongly ('Sunflower', 'Soya', 'oftembotrione'); the image has lowercase and a word space. Source language is English, so `en` repeats `zh` verbatim with no normalisation.

paragraphs.zh: The forms A and C of tembotrione are in particular suitable as desiccants for the desiccation of the aboveground parts of crop plants such as potato, rape, sunflower and soya bean, but also cereals. This enables completely mechanical harvesting of these important crop plants.
paragraphs.en: The forms A and C of tembotrione are in particular suitable as desiccants for the desiccation of the aboveground parts of crop plants such as potato, rape, sunflower and soya bean, but also cereals. This enables completely mechanical harvesting of these important crop plants.
paragraphs.notes: First paragraph in the right column. The OCR layer reads 'Suitable', 'Sunflower' and 'Soya' with spurious capitals; the image has lowercase throughout. Source language is English, so `en` repeats `zh` verbatim with no normalisation.

paragraphs.zh: Also of scientific interest is the facilitation of harvesting which is enabled by the time-concentrated dropping or reduction of the strength of attachment to the tree with citrus fruits, olives or other species and varieties of pomaceous, stone and shelled fruit. The same mechanism, i.e. the promotion of the formation of separation tissue between fruit or leaf and shoot of the plants is also significant for well-controlled defoliation of useful plants, in particular cotton.
paragraphs.en: Also of scientific interest is the facilitation of harvesting which is enabled by the time-concentrated dropping or reduction of the strength of attachment to the tree with citrus fruits, olives or other species and varieties of pomaceous, stone and shelled fruit. The same mechanism, i.e. the promotion of the formation of separation tissue between fruit or leaf and shoot of the plants is also significant for well-controlled defoliation of useful plants, in particular cotton.
paragraphs.notes: The OCR layer renders this marker as '0.095', with a decimal point, which is a misread of the bracketed bold [0095] on the image. paragraphs.zh: In addition, the shortening of the time interval in which the individual cotton plants become ripe leads to heightened fiber quality after the harvest.

paragraphs.zh: Tembotrione in the forms A or C or the plant protection agents containing them can for example be used in the form of directly sprayable aqueous solutions, powders, suspensions and also high concentration aqueous, oily or other suspensions, oil suspensions, pastes, dusting agents, scattering agents or granules by spraying, misting, dusting, scattering or pouring. The use forms are determined by the use purposes; in each case, they should ensure the finest possible distribution of the active substances according to the invention.

The use forms are determined by the use purposes; in each case, they should ensure the finest possible distribution of the active substances according to the invention.

paragraphs.zh: The plant protection agents according to the invention contain tembotrione either in form A or in form C, i.e. in a purity, based on the modification in question, of at least 90 wt. %, and additives and/or carriers such as are usual for the formulation of plant protection agents. In such plant protection agents, the quantity of active substance, i.e. the total quantity of tembotrione and of other active substances if necessary, normally lies in the range from 1 to 98 wt. %, in particular in the range from 10 to 95 wt. %, based on the total weight of the plant protection agent.
paragraphs.en: The plant protection agents according to the invention contain tembotrione either in form A or in form C, i.e. in a purity, based on the modification in question, of at least 90 wt. %, and additives and/or carriers such as are usual for the formulation of plant protection agents. In such plant protection agents, the quantity of active substance, i.e. the total quantity of tembotrione and of other active substances if necessary, normally lies in the range from 1 to 98 wt. %, in particular in the range from 10 to 95 wt. %, based on the total weight of the plant protection agent.
paragraphs.notes: The only paragraph on the page carrying numbers, and every one was read off the image at 2.6x magnification: 'at least 90 wt. %', 'from 1 to 98 wt. %', 'from 10 to 95 wt. %'. All three are printed 'wt. %' with a space between the stop and the percent sign; the OCR layer closes it up to 'wt.%'. The digits 90, 1, 98, 10 and 95 are unambiguous on the image and agree with the layer. Source language is English, so `en` repeats `zh` verbatim with no normalisation.

paragraphs.zh: All solid and liquid substances which are normally used as carriers in plant protection agents, in particular in herbicide formulations are possible as carriers.

paragraphs.zh: Solid carriers are for example mineral earths such as silicic acids, silica gels, silicates, talc, kaolin, limestone, lime, chalk, bole, loess, clay, dolomite, diatomaceous earth, calcium and magnesium sulfate, magnesium oxide, ground plastics, fertilizers such as ammonium sulfate, ammonium phosphate, ammonium nitrate, ureas and plant products such as cereal flour, tree bark, wood and nutshell flour, cellulose powder and other solid carriers.

paragraphs.zh: Liquid carriers, as well as water, are also organic liquids, for example mineral oil fractions of medium to high boiling point such as kerosene and diesel oil, also coal tar oils and oils of plant or animal origin, aliphatic, cyclic and aromatic hydrocarbons, for example paraffins, tetrahydronaphthalene, alkylated naphthalenes and derivatives thereof, alkylated benzenes and derivatives thereof, including aromatic and non-aromatic hydrocarbon mixtures, for example the products marketed under the trade names Exxsol and Solvesso, alcohols such as propanol, butanol and cyclohexanol, ketones such as cyclohexanone, and strongly polar solvents, for example amides such as N-methyl-pyrrolidone.
paragraphs.en: Liquid carriers, as well as water, are also organic liquids, for example mineral oil fractions of medium to high boiling point such as kerosene and diesel oil, also coal tar oils and oils of plant or animal origin, aliphatic, cyclic and aromatic hydrocarbons, for example paraffins, tetrahydronaphthalene, alkylated naphthalenes and derivatives thereof, alkylated benzenes and derivatives thereof, including aromatic and non-aromatic hydrocarbon mixtures, for example the products marketed under the trade names Exxsol and Solvesso, alcohols such as propanol, butanol and cyclohexanol, ketones such as cyclohexanone, and strongly polar solvents, for example amides such as N-methyl-pyrrolidone.
paragraphs.notes: The solvent list on the page, all read off the image: water, kerosene, diesel oil, coal tar oils, paraffins, tetrahydronaphthalene, alkylated naphthalenes, alkylated benzenes, propanol, butanol, cyclohexanol, cyclohexanone, N-methyl-pyrrolidone. discrepancies.what: Paragraph markers are printed WITH square brackets on this page, contrary to the shared vision brief, which states they are bare four-digit numbers.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The image prints bold, bracketed [0088] through [0102] in an unbroken run, brackets clearly visible at 2.4x magnification on every one of the fifteen markers.
discrepancies.text_says: The OCR layer drops the brackets and gives '0088', '0089' and so on, and misreads [0095] as '0.095' and [0100] as '0100' preceded by a line break. The brief's 'bare number' reading comes from this layer, not from the page. The pipeline agrees with the image: pipeline/verify.py sets PARAGRAPH_MARKER = re.compile(r'^(?:\[\d{4}\]|None\s)') and pipeline/make_visual_evidence.py sets MARKER = re.compile(r'^\[\d{4}\]$'), so a bare marker is silently discarded there. Bracketed form recorded.
